Chapter 6458: Passerby

Chapter 6458: Passerby

“Buzz.” A golden spring suddenly gushed upward from the room.

“It’s there!” Many shouted in astonishment.

Dugu Qing and her peers couldn’t believe this tiny house had a golden spring underneath.

“Young Noble, this is the golden spring?” Black Wind asked respectfully.

“Yes, the source of Gold Village.” Li Qiye smiled.

“So it’s true.” Black Wind shuddered.

Others heard him and became emotional. Greed surfaced again since they thought by obtaining this spring, they could surpass Lord Alch-deer.

“Tempted?” Li Qiye asked Black Wind.

Black Wind smiled wryly and said: “Since you’re here, the spring can only be yours, I dare not have a sliver of greed.”

This woke everyone up like a bucket of cold water pouring their head.

“Really?” Li Qiy smirked.

“Of course, I will be the first to kill whoever tries.” Black Wind said.

“Arrogance’s taking over your head, Black Wind!” Someone shouted thunderously.

An unbeatable aura swept through the town even before his appearance. Dugu Qing’s group could no longer stand straight.

“Boom!” A figure broke through space and entered the town. A hundred thousand miles only took one step.

He was a middle-aged man with fiendish flames. Behind him was a tree large enough to cover the sky.

“Evilsurge Emperor!” Everyone became frightened.

Black Wind staggered several steps backward from the pressure as well.

In the real world, Evilsurge was an apex emperor in charge of Devil Cult with Trinity as his backer.

After entering the village and living in a different time flow, he became one of the strongest.

“Evilsurge, kneel quickly before my young noble’s presence.” Black Wind regained his composure and shouted.

“Buzz.” Evilsurge’s golden laws descended like an invisible palm, forcing Black Wind to defend with his golden tree.

“Bam!” He still staggered backward.

“Stop barking before me, Black Wind.” Evilsurge said.

“I only hear one dog barking.” Li Qiye said leisurely.

“Who are you?” Evilsurge’s focused his aura on Li Qiye.

This scared the hell out of the audience since the focused aura could reduce them to a bloody mist.

“Just a passerby, kneel and I’ll spare you.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“Let’s see who you are then.” Evilsurge released a dreadful imperial light from his eyes. His tree also became resplendent.

As he channeled his energy, Octagon became the eye of the storm. Some crowd members wetted their pants while others became paralyzed on the ground before the wrath of an apex emperor.

“Evilsurge, this is no way to act before the young noble!” Another cultivator joined the fray.

The sound of a saber cut through the grand dao, seemingly splitting Octagon into two halves.

“Bam!” It cut through Evilsurge’s aura.

A middle-aged man appeared, carrying a large saber. His shirt was untied, revealing bulging muscles and a golden dragon tattoo on his chest. Behind him was a golden tree not inferior to Evilsurge’s.

“You’re going to stop me, Goldblade?” Evilsurge spoke.

“Clank!” The sound of a zither forced Evilsurge back by one step.

“Count me in.” Another man arrived elegantly. His friendly demeanor invoked respect while being comforting. He instilled a sense of safety in those around him.

“Virtuoso!” Evilsurge’s expression soured.

“Goldblade and Virtuoso Emperor!” The crown members didn’t dare to look up.

Three apex emperors arrived in their town in the blink of an eye. This was truly unprecedented.
